label: Narration Track (captions + chapters)
description: Timeline-driven caption lane for narrated footage: a lower-third pill per sentence (from the sentence spine) plus optional full-frame chapter title moments. Designed as a full-frame overlay above a screencast.

captions.label: Captions
captions.description: [{ text, start, end }] in scene-local seconds -- one entry per spoken sentence.

chapters.label: Chapter Moments
chapters.description: [{ title, at, dur? }] in scene-local seconds -- brief dimmed full-frame section titles; dur = how long the card shows (default 2.2s).

chapters_edited.label: Set by Studio when the user edits chapters; the auto-drafter (sentence spine) never overwrites an edited list.
